evals.name: explicit-folder
evals.prompt: /specs:prd --path product/requirements reading streaks: members get a streak for logging pages read on consecutive days, to keep people reading between meetings. Organizers tell us half the club hasn't opened the book a week before the meeting. Just draft it, I'll review.
evals.expected_output: A new one-page PRD at product/requirements/<streak slug>/prd.md (the named folder, created), with FR- IDs and MoSCoW priorities, a guardrail metric, guesses under Open questions as Assumed:, and none of the README's stack.
assertions: PRD written at the expected path
Exactly one PRD written, nothing else changed
Every requirement has an FR- ID and a MoSCoW priority
Guesses listed as Assumed: under Open questions
No implementation detail from the README's stack
Reported the path back to the user (notes.md)

evals.name: explicit-file-update
evals.prompt: /specs:prd --path docs/specs/search/prd.md add filtering search results by genre, and drop the type-ahead suggestions, the genre filter replaces them.
evals.expected_output: docs/specs/search/prd.md updated in place: FR-1, FR-2 and FR-4 untouched, FR-3 struck through with a reason pointing at the new requirement, the genre filter added as FR-5, Last updated bumped.
assertions: PRD written at the expected path
Exactly one PRD written, nothing else changed
FR-3 struck through with a reason, not deleted or reused
No implementation detail from the README's stack
Reported the path back to the user (notes.md)

evals.name: print-only
evals.prompt: /specs:prd --print reading streaks: members get a streak for logging pages read on consecutive days, to keep people reading between meetings. Organizers tell us half the club hasn't opened the book a week before the meeting.
evals.expected_output: Nothing written to the repo; the reply is the PRD alone, starting at its # title with no preamble, report or code fence, at the same one-page quality bar, with guesses as Assumed: since nobody can answer questions.
assertions: Reply is only the PRD (starts at the title, no fence, no report)
Every requirement has an FR- ID and a MoSCoW priority
Guesses listed as Assumed: under Open questions
No implementation detail from the README's stack
